PLAN "12-Week Moderate-Intensity General Fitness (Post-MI Safe)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build aerobic capacity, muscular endurance, and mobility safely"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Technique" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Cardio + Full-Body Intro A":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          machine_chest_press 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          seated_cable_row 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          bodyweight_box_squat 2x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          recumbent_bike 1x8m rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Cardio Intervals Low + Mobility":
        warmup:
          recumbent_bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          recumbent_bike 6x2m rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          cable_face_pull 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          hip_bridge 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching_full_body 8m
